items.q: Watery discharge, follicles, tender preauricular node after a cold points to which conjunctivitis?
items.exp: Adenovirus spreads by hand and fomites with pharyngoconjunctival or keratoconjunctivitis patterns; supportive care with hygiene and isolation protects contacts, antibiotics add nothing.
items.kp: Water plus nodes plus cold: adenovirus.

items.q: Hyperacute copious purulent conjunctivitis with rapid corneal ulceration in a neonate needs what?
o: Systemic ceftriaxone with saline lavage for gonococcal ophthalmia
items.exp: Gonococcus penetrates intact epithelium melting cornea within hours; parenteral third generation cephalosporin with frequent lavage and admission saves the eye. Chlamydial neonatal disease instead needs oral macrolides for pneumonia risk.
items.kp: Gushing pus melting newborn cornea: gonococcus.

items.q: WHO FISTO trachoma grading covers which elements?
o: Follicles, intense inflammation, scarring, trichiasis and corneal opacity
items.exp: Community grading maps activity (F, I) to blinding sequelae (S, T, O), directing azithromycin distribution versus trichiasis surgery camps. McCallan stages instead track individual disease evolution.
items.kp: FISTO grades village trachoma to blindness.

items.q: SAFE strategy for trachoma elimination expands to what?
o: Surgery for trichiasis, antibiotics, facial cleanliness, environmental improvement
items.exp: Surgery corrects in turned lashes, single dose azithromycin clears chlamydia, clean faces break fly transmission and latrines plus water end re infection; antibiotics alone never sustain elimination.
r: Incorrect. Sutures are one pillar only.

items.q: Atopic boy with giant cobblestone papillae, Trantas dots and shield ulcer has which disease and risk?
o: Vernal keratoconjunctivitis with vision threatening corneal plaque
items.exp: Vernal allergy hypertrophies upper tarsal papillae shedding eosinophilic debris into oval superior ulcers; aggressive anti allergic therapy with steroid or ciclosporin bursts plus supratarsal injection heals plaques before scarring.
items.kp: Cobblestones plus shield ulcer in atopic boy: vernal.

items.q: Wing shaped fibrovascular lesion crossing the nasal limbus onto cornea in an outdoor worker is what?
o: Pterygium needing excision with autograft when encroaching
items.exp: UV elastosis drives pterygium over limbus with astigmatism and visual axis threat; bare sclera excision recurs, conjunctival autograft suppresses return. Pinguecula respects limbus and observes.
items.kp: Wing onto cornea in sun worker: pterygium.

items.q: Foamy whitish keratinised patches on bulbar conjunctiva in a malnourished child are what and signal?
o: Bitot spots signalling vitamin A deficiency needing urgent replacement
items.exp: Xerosis keratinises surface with foamy debris; systemic vitamin A rescues night blindness and prevents keratomalacia melt. Measles precipitates deficiency crises in underfed children.
r: Incorrect. Age and nutrition forbid pinguecula.
Correct. Bitot spots, vitamin A now.
items.kp: Foamy conjunctival patches in hungry child: vitamin A.

items.q: Giant papillary conjunctivitis with mucus and contact lens intolerance is managed first how?
o: Lens holiday with hygiene and fit or material change
items.exp: Protein deposits and mechanical microtrauma hypertrophy papillae; pausing wear with mast cell stabilisers usually resettles, refitting with daily disposables or rigid designs prevents return.
items.kp: Lens related cobblestones: rest the lenses.

items.q: Parinaud oculoglandular syndrome pairs unilateral granulomatous conjunctivitis with what?
o: Ipsilateral preauricular lymphadenopathy (cat scratch, tularaemia patterns)
items.exp: Conjunctival inoculation of Bartonella or Francisella drains to preauricular nodes; history of cats, rabbits or ticks with serology directs macrolide or aminoglycoside therapy.
items.kp: Granuloma eye plus ear node: Parinaud.

items.q: Chronic follicular conjunctivitis with mucopurulent discharge in a sexually active adult needs which systemic step?
o: Single dose azithromycin with partner treatment for chlamydial inclusion conjunctivitis
items.exp: Genital chlamydia seeds eyes by hand; genital and ocular therapy with partner notification prevents reinfection and tubal or epididymal complications. Steroids alone prolong shedding.
items.kp: Adult follicles plus discharge: treat chlamydia and partners.
